Aquaplaning is caused by the accumulation of water on the road and by irregularities in its surface. Therefore, when it rains, it is necessary to pay special attention to potholes and areas in which puddles may occur.

RISK GROUPS  
5 Pedestrians
Pedestrians are particularly vulnerable, because in the event of a collision they are more likely to suffer serious injury.
Statistics indicate that the probability of being killed in a collision is greater on main roads than in built-up areas, mainly due to high speeds. However, most pedestrian deaths from car accidents occur on urban roads, which is where pedestrians are more often hit by vehicles.
This high accident rate is linked mostly to the zone of uncertainty of pedestrians, making their movements less predictable than those of other road users, which means that the driver finds it harder to anticipate their behaviour and actions.
(Página 251 del manual 'Learning to drive')

5 Vertical Signs                              
                           
5.3 Regulation road signs
5.3.5 Other signs relating to prohibition or restriction
R-300 Minimum Separation
It prohibits maintaining a safety distance with the vehicle ahead less than the distance indicated on the sign, except in overtakes.
If the distance is not shown on the road sign then you must maintain a good safety distance between your vehicle and the vehicle ahead, according to your speed (and the grip of the road surface) and any other legal requirements.
(Página 126 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.help:
3 Moderate speed  
 
All drivers should travel at a moderate speed and, if necessary, even stop their vehicle when the circumstances require it. The following are circumstances that are likely to be encountered and where speed should be moderated to take into account the given situation:
In the proximity of a bus, either, nearing or stationary at a bus stop, especially a bus carrying out school transport.
Outside populated areas when approaching vehicles stopped on the road, assistance vehicles providing a service or bicycles using the road or hard shoulder.
When travelling on slippery roads or when you encounter surface water or gravel or other objects that may affect yours and other road users safety if negotiated at an ‘xcesive speed’
(Página 172 del manual 'Learning to drive')
